defs.meaning: 产出，结局；效果（outcome 的复数）

examples.en: All of these outcomes are linked to a lack of physical exercise.
examples.zh: 所有这些后果都与缺乏体育锻炼有关。

examples.en: Teachers imagine they will improve outcomes if they tailor their presentations to each student.
examples.zh: 教师们认为，如果他们为每个学生量身定制他们的演示文稿，就会提高教学效果。

examples.en: Four possible outcomes have been identified.
examples.zh: 现已确定有四种可能的结果。
